# github-api-lite

Minimal GitHub REST client over an injected transport: Link header pagination, primary and secondary rate limit handling and same-origin page links. Python package `github_api_lite`, standard library only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): installation and usage examples.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): transport protocol and pagination logic.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and safety limits.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): testing approach with FakeTransport.
